title: Harmine inhibits non-small cell lung cancer growth by targeting phosphodiesterase4D and inducing ferroptosis.
authors: He, Jinrong; Xiong, Qi; Qi, Yu; Peng, Caixia; Hu, Linling; Xia, Mingfeng; Zhu, Biqiang; Xu, Bo; Ding, Yu
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子药物harmine通过靶向PDE4D诱导铁死亡抑制肺癌，核心是药物-蛋白互作与肿瘤表型，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) is a major cause of cancer-related death, and resistance to conventional therapies underscores the urgent need for novel treatment strategies. Ferroptosis, an iron-dependent form of regulated cell death, offers a promising alternative to overcome apoptosis resistance. Harmine (HM), a natural beta-carboline alkaloid, exhibits antitumor activity in various cancers, but its potential in NSCLC and the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. PURPOSE: This study investigates the anti-NSCLC effects of harmine and aims to define its molecular target and mechanism, with a focus on ferroptosis induction. METHODS: The effects of harmine on NSCLC cells (A549, H1299) were assessed by CCK-8, colony formation, wound healing, Transwell, EdU, and flow cytometry. Ferroptosis was assessed by measuring ROS, iron accumulation, lipid peroxidation, and expression of key markers (GPX4, SLC7A11) via qPCR and Western blot; PI3K-Akt-Nrf2 signaling activity was evaluated by Western blot. Target identification integrated network pharmacology, molecular docking, and CETSA; the interaction between phosphodiesterase 4D (PDE4D) and PI3K was confirmed by co-immunoprecipitation. The role of PDE4D was further validated by overexpression, siRNA knockdown, and PDE4D-F332A rescue. In vivo efficacy and safety were tested in A549 xenograft models. RESULTS: Harmine suppressed NSCLC cell proliferation and migration, induced G0/G1 arrest, and promoted apoptosis. It triggered ferroptosis, as shown by Fe(2)(+) accumulation, lipid peroxidation, upregulation of PTGS2, ACSL4, and LPCAT3, and downregulation of GPX4, SLC7A11, and Nrf2. These phenotypes were reversed by Ferrostatin-1 in assays of cell viability, lipid peroxidation, and iron levels. Mechanistically, harmine bound PDE4D, disrupted its interaction with PI3K, and inhibited the PI3K-Akt-Nrf2 axis. PDE4D overexpression counteracted harmine's effects, whereas mutation of the harmine-binding residue Phe-332 (PDE4D-F332A) abrogated its antitumor activity. In vivo, harmine significantly inhibited tumor growth without evident systemic toxicity. CONCLUSION: Harmine exerts antitumor effects in NSCLC by inducing ferroptosis through direct targeting of PDE4D and suppression of the PI3K-Akt-Nrf2 pathway, highlighting PDE4D as a novel therapeutic target and harmine as a promising candidate for NSCLC treatment.
abstract_zh: 背景：非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）是癌症相关死亡的主要原因，对常规疗法的耐药性凸显了对新型治疗策略的迫切需求。铁死亡（ferroptosis）是一种铁依赖性的调节性细胞死亡形式，为克服凋亡耐药提供了有前景的替代途径。骆驼蓬碱（Harmine, HM）是一种天然β-咔啉生物碱，在多种癌症中表现出抗肿瘤活性，但其在NSCLC中的潜力及潜在机制尚不清楚。目的：本研究探讨骆驼蓬碱的抗NSCLC作用，并旨在明确其分子靶点和机制，重点关注铁死亡诱导。方法：通过CCK-8、集落形成、伤口愈合、Transwell、EdU和流式细胞术评估骆驼蓬碱对NSCLC细胞（A549、H1299）的影响。通过测量ROS、铁积累、脂质过氧化以及关键标志物（GPX4、SLC7A11）的表达（采用qPCR和Western blot）评估铁死亡；通过Western blot评估PI3K-Akt-Nrf2信号通路活性。靶点鉴定整合了网络药理学、分子对接和CETSA；通过免疫共沉淀确认磷酸二酯酶4D（PDE4D）与PI3K之间的相互作用。通过过表达、siRNA敲低和PDE4D-F332A拯救实验进一步验证PDE4D的作用。在A549异种移植模型中测试体内疗效和安全性。结果：骆驼蓬碱抑制NSCLC细胞增殖和迁移，诱导G0/G1期阻滞，并促进凋亡。它触发铁死亡，表现为Fe(2)(+)积累、脂质过氧化、PTGS2、ACSL4和LPCAT3上调，以及GPX4、SLC7A11和Nrf2下调。这些表型在细胞活力、脂质过氧化和铁水平检测中被Ferrostatin-1逆转。机制上，骆驼蓬碱结合PDE4D，破坏其与PI3K的相互作用，并抑制PI3K-Akt-Nrf2轴。PDE4D过表达抵消了骆驼蓬碱的作用，而骆驼蓬碱结合残基Phe-332的突变（PDE4D-F332A）则消除了其抗肿瘤活性。在体内，骆驼蓬碱显著抑制肿瘤生长，且无明显全身毒性。结论：骆驼蓬碱通过直接靶向PDE4D并抑制PI3K-Akt-Nrf2通路诱导铁死亡，从而在NSCLC中发挥抗肿瘤作用，凸显PDE4D作为新型治疗靶点以及骆驼蓬碱作为NSCLC治疗的有前景候选药物。
